title: These Are The Only 20 Tools You Need.
description:
ChatGPT is dead. Here are the 20 AI tools that replaced it.

I run an AI agency. I tested every tool with my team worth testing this year and twenty made the cut. Some will print money for you. Some are massively overhyped. One I haven't even touched but my team vouched for it.

I've prepared a detailed guide on everything that is useful by the beginning of May 2026: every tool ranked, my honest verdict, and exactly how to use each one in your business.

Comment 'List' below and I'll DM you the AI tools.
